title: Assessing Competitiveness
headline: Only the financial-ratio half of 3.3.5 is taught (and it omits the acid test and substitutes operating profit margin for the spec's profit for the year margin): the two financial statements are never introduced, stakeholder interest appears nowhere, and the entire human resources section — labour productivity, turnover, retention, absenteeism, their limitations, and all four HR strategies — exists only in flashcards and quiz answers, while the notes instead teach off-spec UK A-level material (VRIO, Porter's Five Forces, balanced scorecard, benchmarking, triple bottom line).
